## MarkdownFeature.definition() method

The [MarkdownFeature.definition()](./api-documenter.markdownfeature.definition.md) method creates a plugin feature definition from the given name and configuration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static definition(featureName: string, featureConfig: MarkdownFeatureConfig): IFeatureDefinition;
```

The plugin feature definition object.

## Example


```ts
import { MarkdownFeature } from "@positron/api-documenter";

const feature = MarkdownFeature.definition("my-feature", {
  onBeforeWritePage: ({ content }) => {
    // do something with page

    return content;
  },
});

export const apiDocumenterPluginManifest = {
  features: [feature],
};
```
